mentions.name: Stopping Agents
mentions.description: This project provides open-source LLM agents that stop conversations early to save time. The agents are trained with imitation learning rather than reinforcement learning, making them scalable and easy to deploy with your own data. They are mainly aimed at quickly disqualifying prospects in sales calls but can be applied more broadly.
mentions.problem: Conversations, especially sales calls, run too long; these agents end them early to save time.
mentions.audience: Primarily sales teams quickly disqualifying prospects on sales calls, though applicable more broadly
